BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.title: Menitas
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Who wishes to gaze upon my glorious work?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Ah, a mortal. Tell me what you desire.
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: You again. Perhaps it's time one of these glorious creations saw usage in the battlefield anyways
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.title: Karyei
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: It is good to see your face for the last time.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Life spends itself trying to find order, but there is only Us.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: We were here before Everything, and We will be here after.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.ancie: We see you bound by chains. We will not fix it, but we will change you, as all things must.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.anci: The anger in you... it is beautiful, uncontrolled.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.ancie: The world reviles Us, but it needs Us. So we act.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancient: Your sisters once tried hunting Us. We let them have a piece, as a mercy.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancien: Why do you prize the trophy, rather than the hunt?
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancient: Lovely wretch, keep bringing Us that poison. Its potency is sanguine.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancient: A mortal rebuilding itself. Effortlessly admirable.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancien: Oh, what We would give to take a look in your Mind. Ah, well. In due Time...
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancient: Your orbs... concentrated power. Have you thought what would happen if you were to unleash their full potential?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.title: Phthalo
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Sugar, you look tired. Care for tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Growth requires pain, but through blossoming there is beauty.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: I have seen death more times than I can count, yet I create anyway. Take what you wish.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.2-0r.ancient: I know what you are, puppet of Neow, but I do not blame you. She repurposes my beauty because she wants what I have.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.anci: Creature of Flesh and Blood, why do you hate others so when they are the same as you?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.anc: It seems hubris to wrap yourself in steel when nature provides the greatest armor.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.anci: Extinction always brings me sorrow... the Valleyguards you slaughtered, I knew them well.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancien: Creature of Blight and Breath, it pains me to see a being stuck constantly between life and death.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancie: I admire a hunter such as you, but it is curious that you do not use your prizes to sustain yourself
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancien: I must apologize for your condition, Creature of Blight and Breath. It was my teas on which your disease was based.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancien: Creature of Steel and Wire, you are not one of mine, but yet you have the same spark in your soul.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancie: I have been trying to carve a creature like you, yet I can not seem to replicate your sentience. Tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancien: You seem to take a liking to my tea. How is this, when you cannot drink like we can?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.title: Mnemi
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: [i][font_size=22]just close your eyes, soon you'll be home...[/font_size][/i]
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.ancien: last bastion. do you have loved ones?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.ancie: your pain makes me proud. it reminds me that i am alive.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.ancien: last bastion, your memories remain spotty. what did that neow do to you?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancient: forgotten sister. what do you cherish most?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancient: memories are wonderful trophies, but to give them away is the most wonderful trophy of all
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancient: the blight in you... it plagues your mind. we are both ghosts still cursed to walk, forgotten sister.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancient: remaining half. you have memories from artifice, how curious...
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancient: you have a past worth pursuing, but no amount of fixing will bring it back.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancient: you are just as alive as every other mortal i've seen walk in here, if not more, remaining half. remember this.
